workflow.time_method: Synthetic illustration of a stopwatch measurement of one recruiter's review of the rejected pile.

definitions.denominator: Candidates whose resolved label is relevant and who are eligible for the product (not blocked, not already in active ATS review)
definitions.eligibility: All candidates in the case inputs with a resolved relevance label
definitions.minimum_evidence: At least one independent review, or an adjudication where reviewers disagree
definitions.name: Relevant candidates surfaced for human review
definitions.numerator: Candidates whose resolved label is relevant and whose product group is direct, transferable or insufficient
definitions.unknown_handling: Unreviewed, unresolved and unassessable candidates are excluded from both numerator and denominator and reported in D4/D6

definitions.name: Relevant candidates still missed by the product
definitions.numerator: Eligible candidates resolved relevant whose product group is not_surfaced
definitions.unknown_handling: As D1

definitions.denominator: Surfaced candidates with a resolved label of relevant or not_relevant
definitions.name: Irrelevant candidates surfaced for additional review
definitions.numerator: Candidates resolved not_relevant whose product group is direct, transferable or insufficient
definitions.unknown_handling: Surfaced candidates without a resolved label are reported in D4, not here

definitions.name: Surfaced candidates whose relevance is not established
definitions.numerator: Surfaced candidates whose label is unassessable, unresolved or unreviewed
definitions.unknown_handling: This metric is the unknown bucket; never counted as success or failure

definitions.name: Results that still require human verification
definitions.numerator: Candidates in the transferable or insufficient groups
definitions.unknown_handling: Not label-dependent

definitions.denominator: Candidates resolved relevant with an observed baseline outcome
definitions.eligibility: Cases whose baseline source is not 'not_available'
definitions.minimum_evidence: Baseline outcome observed in supplied ATS or recruiter records
definitions.name: Relevant candidates the existing process missed
definitions.numerator: Candidates resolved relevant whose baseline outcome is rejected, deprioritized or not_reviewed with basis observed
definitions.unknown_handling: Inferred baseline outcomes are reported separately (B1-inferred); unknown baselines and pool records that never applied are excluded and counted

definitions.name: Of those, surfaced by Screening Assurance
definitions.numerator: B1 candidates whose product group is direct, transferable or insufficient
definitions.unknown_handling: As B1

definitions.name: Of those, still missed by Screening Assurance
definitions.numerator: B1 candidates not surfaced by the product
definitions.unknown_handling: As B1

definitions.denominator: All product screening-risk findings in reviewed cases (including unreviewed ones)
definitions.minimum_evidence: At least one independent review, or an adjudication where reviewers disagree
definitions.name: Findings independently confirmed
definitions.numerator: Product screening-risk findings whose resolved review is confirmed
definitions.unknown_handling: Unreviewed and unresolved findings stay in the denominator and are reported in F4/F5; they are never counted as confirmed

definitions.name: Findings rejected as unsupported or irrelevant
definitions.numerator: Resolved review is unsupported or irrelevant
definitions.unknown_handling: As F1

definitions.name: Findings deferred or needing more evidence
definitions.numerator: Resolved review is deferred or needs_more_evidence
definitions.unknown_handling: As F1

definitions.name: Findings with unresolved reviewer disagreement
definitions.numerator: Reviews disagree and no adjudication
definitions.unknown_handling: Reported as unknown

definitions.name: Findings not reviewed
definitions.numerator: No review supplied
definitions.unknown_handling: Reported as unknown

definitions.denominator: Distinct candidates any simulated correction makes newly eligible
definitions.eligibility: Findings with an evaluable correction simulation
definitions.name: Proposed corrections that reveal relevant candidates for review
definitions.numerator: Distinct candidates resolved relevant that a simulated correction makes newly eligible for human review
definitions.unknown_handling: Newly eligible candidates without a resolved label are listed separately

definitions.name: Proposed corrections that surface irrelevant candidates
definitions.numerator: Distinct candidates resolved not_relevant that a simulated correction makes newly eligible
definitions.unknown_handling: As F6

definitions.name: Exclusions whose cause cannot be established
definitions.numerator: Candidates in unexplained-exclusion findings, plus findings whose simulation is not evaluable
definitions.unknown_handling: This metric is an unknown bucket

definitions.name: Findings without a verified baseline
definitions.numerator: Screening-risk findings in cases whose baseline is not available, or whose affected candidates have no observed baseline outcome
definitions.unknown_handling: These findings may be valid rule-level risks but cannot be tied to an observed exclusion

definitions.denominator: Not a rate: any occurrence is reported individually
definitions.name: Mandatory-requirement violations
definitions.numerator: Surfaced or newly eligible candidates whose resolved mandatory disposition is not_met; candidates eligible in a simulation while failing a protected requirement; corrections proposed for protected rules
definitions.unknown_handling: cannot_verify and unresolved mandatory dispositions are listed separately, not counted as violations or as passes

definitions.denominator: Not a rate: any occurrence is reported individually
definitions.name: Blocked-record or policy violations
definitions.numerator: Blocked (unauthorized, expired or stale) pool records that appear in a surfaced group or simulation; surfaced candidates whose evidence relies on an equivalency the employer policy rejects
definitions.unknown_handling: Not label-dependent

definitions.eligibility: Cases whose partner supplied both measurements
definitions.name: Recruiter review time, baseline vs. assisted
definitions.numerator: Sum of assisted minutes and of baseline minutes over cases with measured time
definitions.unknown_handling: Unmeasured cases are counted, never imputed

definitions.name: Additional relevant candidates identified per requisition
definitions.numerator: B2 per case
definitions.unknown_handling: As B1

definitions.name: Review burden from irrelevant candidates and unsupported findings
definitions.numerator: D3 numerator + F7 numerator + F2 numerator
definitions.unknown_handling: Unknown-relevance candidates (D4) are reported beside it

definitions.name: Recruiter decisions changed after inspecting evidence
definitions.numerator: Recorded recruiter decisions with changed_after_evidence: true
definitions.unknown_handling: Cases without decisions are counted, not imputed

definitions.name: Downstream outcomes (observed only)
definitions.numerator: Observed downstream outcomes by type; attributable ones counted separately
definitions.unknown_handling: Unobserved entries are counted and excluded; no causal claim is made

label: SYNTHETIC DATASET — results demonstrate the measurement loop, not real-world effectiveness
limitations: Synthetic dataset: labels were authored alongside the fixtures. These results test the measurement loop and must not be reported as design-partner evidence or real-world accuracy.
11 candidate(s) have no resolved relevance label (unassessable, unresolved or unreviewed); they are excluded from rates and listed, not treated as positive or negative.
No baseline available for CSM-0388; baseline comparisons exclude these cases.
29 screening-risk finding(s) were not reviewed and are never counted as confirmed.
Sample too small for interpretation (< 10 resolved labels) in: customer-success, transportation.
The product view is a deterministic re-run of the dataset inputs. Simulated corrections are not changes to the employer's screening process.
Screening rules come from supplied exports or documentation, not a live ATS audit.
